title: Masooma e qum Fatima

<<DIVIDER>>
Pasbaan-e-Wadiy-e-Qum Par Salaam
Tu's Ki Tum Fatema Tum Par Salaam
Bhayi Ki Ulfat Ki Maari Par Salaam
Ho Salam Uss Gham Guzari Par Salam
Ay Khwahar-e-Maula Reza, Massum-e-Qum Fatema (x2)
<<MINI>>
Massuma-e-Qum (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Aap Key Rozey Pei Hazir
Hogaya Yeh Kafela (x2)
Sab Kanizein Aap Ki Hai
Sarey Khudaam-e-Wafa (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Sab Muhibbey Aley Ahmad Gham Gussar-e-Karbala
Hogayi Hamko Ziyarat, Aapki Shukr-e-Khuda ...
Roza-e-Aqdas Pei Yeh
Aya Hamey Hukm-e-Imaam (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Aap Ki Khidmat Mei Bibi
Peysh Kartey Hai Salaam (x2)
Ham Azadar-e-Hussaini Aap Key Adna Ghulaam
Sab Key Daman Mei Muradey, Sab Key Lab Par Hai Dua ...
<<DIVIDER>>
Ham To Aey Hai Yahan
Matam Guzari Key Liyey (x2)
Karbala Walon Key Gham Mei
Aah-ho Zari Key Liyey (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Sina Ko Bhi Key Liyey Aur Ashq Bari Key Liyey
Pursa-e-Shabbir Deney, Aey Hai Ehl-e-Azaa ...
Lijiyey Akbar Ka Pursa
Woh Jo Tha Laila Ka Laal (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo Shabih-e-Mustafa
Woh Peykar-e-Yussuf Jawaan (x2)
Haey Aissey Naujawan Ka Yeh Huwa Maqtal Mei Haal
Jaissey Hi Barchi Khichi Bahar Kaleja Agaya ...
<<DIVIDER>>
Chu'm Kar Abbas Key
Shanon Ko Kehte They Imaam (x2)
Yeh Mere Bazu Hai Bhayi
Aenguey Yeh Mere Kaam (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar Juka Kar Boley Ghazi Aap Aqa Mein Ghulam
Mein Utarunga Inhey Shanon Sey Sadqa Aap Ka ..
